mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and blood pressure while chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium) and can potentiate cardiac arrhythmias; combined use increases cardiovascular stress and arrhythmia risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; monitor blood pressure, heart rate, serum electrolytes, and ECG; consider alternative ADHD agents with lower sympathomimetic effects.
